method.coordinates: First-review WGS84 polygons projected to each raw asset native CRS and native pixel grid. Second polygons use their frozen native pixels. IoU and center distances computed in the native grid, without stretching WGS84 bounding boxes.
method.primary_match: One-to-one descending IoU matching at IoU>=0.25. Every eligible first/second node has exactly one eligible edge, so no assignment ambiguity occurred. Report center distances and mutual centroid containment separately.
method.scope_boundary_rule: A center within 0.5 native pixels of the first reviewed-area boundary is a boundary case; not a clear interior omission.
method.clear_area_rule: Intersect the first declared reviewed area only when its decision is candidates or empty, with the second area excluding recorded abstention locator boxes. A first-pass uncertain decision contributes no agreed clear evidence; its declared geometry is still retained for scope comparison.
method.uncertainty_rule: No candidate in an uncertain area is not an agreed negative. No inter-review agreement is human truth or independent validation.
method.box_dimensions: Box dimensions are not interpreted as vessel length.
method.postfreeze_sources: Only the two review JSON files and raw PNG SHA checks. No detector/model outputs. Root supplied separate raw-image S2 adjudication steering, kept as a proposal pending its final geometry freeze.

interpretation: All 41 first-pass candidate boxes have a geometric partner. There are no first-only candidates.

Of seven second-only boxes, five are outside the original reviewed area, one is exactly on its boundary with half the box inside, and one formalizes the faint PBR SAR return explicitly described as uncertain in the first note.
Scenes 6,9,10,12 change from uncertain to partial empty. This is a scope/evidence-policy difference, not a positive-vs-negative disagreement.
Only PBR S2 scenes 7 and 8 are explicitly empty in both passes; their common clear extents are respectively 100% and about 89.9% of the manifest zone.
Root subsequently froze 43 AI visual positives across eight observation areas; STC12 uses the conservative 47.7% area. This comparison itself creates no labels or import.
